_readme: SYNTHETIC indicator cache. Every entry below is invented and uses addresses
reserved for documentation (RFC 5737 / RFC 3849) and example.* domains. None
of it is real threat intelligence and none of it should be used to block
Bishop reads reputation from a cache rather than calling a feed at triage
time, for three reasons set out in src/bishop/detectors/intel.py: a detector
that makes a network call is not reproducible, resolving attacker
infrastructure during triage tells the attacker their payload landed, and the
offline demo has to run with no credentials.
To populate this with real indicators from abuse.ch, run `just intel`. Their
terms permit use but not redistribution, so the fetched cache is gitignored
and this synthetic one is what ships.
source: hand-written for the Bishop golden corpus
